sentences.text:
Under Sections 498A/302/34 Of The ... vs In Re: Aruna Roy @
Jhako Roy & Anr on 10 September, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen  10.09.2024  Court No.29  Item No. 63  Allowed  ar  CRM (A) 3214 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Sectio
Procedure Code corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharat
Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Banshihari Poli
121 of 2024 dated 28.04.2024 corresponding to G.R Case No  under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And  In Re: Aruna Roy @ Jhako Roy & Anr.
 Petitio  Mr. Kaushik Chowdhury  For the Petit  Ms. Faria Hossain  Mr. Arani Bhattacharyya  For the State  1.
counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are neighbours and they have been falsely implicated.

2. Learned counsel for the State in opposing the prayer for anticipatory bail submits that the petitioners are the village people and neighbours who gathered at the house of the victim and assaulted her.
3. Considering the materials available in case diary, the statement of the neighbours wherefrom it appears that the victim has love relationship with one Utpal Roy.

It is alleged that said Utpal Roy along with his wife and other villagers have raided the house of the petitioners and also taking into consideration that no specific overt act has been attributed to the present petitioners in respect of the alleged offence and apparently it appears that the victim has committed suicide, we are of the Under Sections 498A/302/34 Of The ... vs In Re: Aruna Roy @ Jhako Roy & Anr on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151289827/
1 view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.

Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 12 th of September 2024 11:07:06 AM 4.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Aruna Roy @ Jhako Roy and Felani Roy shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/- each, with two registered sureties of like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

The petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gangarampur at Buniadpur,
Dakshin Dinajpur, within two weeks from date in connection with G.R Case No. 419 of 2024.
In the event of non-compliance of any of the conditions, the anticipatory bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed and the same is accordingly disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Prasenjit Biswas, J) Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 12 th of September 2024 11:07:06 AM Under Sections 498A/302/34 Of The ... vs In Re: Aruna Roy @ Jhako Roy & Anr on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151289827/
